items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Shredman Brothers of New England or a Tom Rockwell in New York

ctx.x: You do that when you go into campuses and --
Damn right I do, and I'd be glad to make the loudest speech they ever heard, because I think it's very unfair, very unfortunate and it's full of shit.

You see, they've taken away any incentive for a Shredman Brothers of New England or a Tom Rockwell in New York or all the things (unintelligible) and reinvest and invest money in new groups and the whole idea, because they've proven in their way through the media of radio, and of the record industry, above all, --
